summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine share buyback transaction under its existing programme. On 8 July 2026, the company repurchased 10,000,000 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 111.8952 pence per share (range 110.65-113.60 pence) through Goldman Sachs International. The shares are intended to be cancelled. This is a routine open-market repurchase under a previously announced buyback programme, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, premium, or structural complexities warranting categorization beyond None.
